        var openModal = function () { addClass(modal, 'nd-open'); };

        var showToast = function () {
            if (!toast) { return; }

            if (toastTimer) { clearTimeout(toastTimer); }
            toastTimer = setTimeout(function () { removeClass(toast, 'nd-open'); }, 2200);
        };
        var popup = function (url) {
            var w = 600, h = 540;
            var sw = window.screen && window.screen.width ? window.screen.width : w;
            var sh = window.screen && window.screen.height ? window.screen.height : h;
            var left = Math.max(0, Math.round((sw - w) / 2));

                ta.style.position = 'fixed';
                ta.style.top = '-1000px';

                var ok = document.execCommand('copy');
                document.body.removeChild(ta);
                if (ok) { showToast(); }
            } catch (e) {}
        };
        var copyLink = function () {
            if (navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText) {
                navigator.clipboard.writeText(pageUrl).then(showToast, copyFallback);

<script type="text/javascript">
(function () {
    try {
        var box = document.getElementById('nd-live');
        var list = document.getElementById('nd-live-list');
        if (!box || !list || !window.XMLHttpRequest) { return; }
        var url = box.getAttribute('data-nd-live-url');
        if (!url) { return; }
        var busy = false, fails = 0, timer = null;
        var hide = function () { box.style.display = 'none'; list.innerHTML = ''; };
        var failed = function () {
            fails++;
            if (fails >= 3) {
                if (timer) { clearInterval(timer); timer = null; }
                hide();
            }
        };
        var load = function () {
            if (document.hidden || busy || fails >= 3) { return; }
            busy = true;
            var xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
            xhr.open('GET', url, true);
            xhr.onreadystatechange = function () {
                if (xhr.readyState !== 4) { return; }
                busy = false;
                if (xhr.status !== 200) { failed(); return; }
                fails = 0;
                var html = xhr.responseText || '';
                // only the row block is accepted (a redirect to another page would come back as a whole document)
                if (html.indexOf('<html') < 0 && html.indexOf('nd-lv-row') >= 0) {
                    list.innerHTML = html;
                    box.style.display = 'block';
                } else {
                    hide();
                }
            };
            try { xhr.send(); } catch (e) { busy = false; failed(); }
        };
        load();
        timer = setInterval(load, 60000);
        document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', function () { if (!document.hidden) { load(); } });
    } catch (e) {}
})();
</script>

<script>
    // Task 14: convert the kick-off time in the FAQ (UTC, data-utc in Y-m-d H:i format) to the client machine time. Parsed manually, not relying on Date(string).
    // If parsing fails, keep the "d/m/Y H:i GMT+0" the server printed.
    (function () {
        try {
            var els = document.querySelectorAll('.js-kickoff-local');
            if (!els || !els.length) { return; }
            var pad = function (n) { return n < 10 ? '0' + n : '' + n; };
            for (var i = 0; i < els.length; i++) {
                var el = els[i];
                var utc = el.getAttribute('data-utc') || '';
                var m = /^\s*(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})\s+(\d{2}):(\d{2})\s*$/.exec(utc);
                if (!m) { continue; }
                var ts = Date.UTC(parseInt(m[1], 10), parseInt(m[2], 10) - 1, parseInt(m[3], 10), parseInt(m[4], 10), parseInt(m[5], 10));
                if (isNaN(ts)) { continue; }
                var d = new Date(ts);
                if (isNaN(d.getTime())) { continue; }
                var offsetMin = -d.getTimezoneOffset();
                var sign = offsetMin < 0 ? '-' : '+';
                var absMin = Math.abs(offsetMin);
                var offH = Math.floor(absMin / 60);
                var offM = Math.round(absMin % 60);
                var gmt = 'GMT' + sign + offH + (offM ? ':' + pad(offM) : '');
                var text = pad(d.getDate()) + '/' + pad(d.getMonth() + 1) + '/' + d.getFullYear() + ' ' + pad(d.getHours()) + ':' + pad(d.getMinutes());
                el.textContent = text + ' ' + gmt;
            }
        } catch (e) {}
    })();
</script>

<script>
(function () {
    var KEY = 'bt_follow_v1', MAX = 12, T = {"follow":"Follow","following":"Following","follow-league":"Follow league","follow-toast-on":"You follow %s. Their matches now appear first on your home page.","follow-toast-note":"Saved on this device - no account needed. Tap the star again to unfollow.","follow-toast-off":"You no longer follow %s.","follow-toast-full":"You can follow up to 12. Remove one first.","follow-toast-fail":"Could not save on this device (private mode or storage is full)."};
    function load() {
        try {
            var d = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY) || '{}');

    function esc(s) { return String(s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, function (c) { return { '&': '&', '<': '<', '>': '>', '"': '"', "'": ''' }[c]; }); }
    function bucket(d, type) { return type === 'league' ? d.l : d.t; }
    function paint(btn, d) {
        var on = !!bucket(d, btn.getAttribute('data-follow-type'))[btn.getAttribute('data-follow-id')];
        btn.className = btn.className.replace(/(^|\s)is-on(?=\s|$)/g, '') + (on ? ' is-on' : '');
        btn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', on ? 'true' : 'false');
        var star = btn.querySelector('.bt-follow-star'), label = btn.querySelector('.bt-follow-label');

        if (label) { label.innerHTML = esc(on ? T['following'] : (btn.getAttribute('data-follow-type') === 'league' ? T['follow-league'] : T['follow'])); }
    }
    function paintAll() {
        var d = load(), btns = document.querySelectorAll('.bt-follow');
        for (var i = 0; i < btns.length; i++) { paint(btns[i], d); }
    }
    // height taken by fixed bottom units that are on screen (cookie banner, sticky sponsor): our bars go above them
    function bottomOffset() {
        var h = 0, sel = ['#onetrust-banner-sdk', '.cashfish-wrapper', '.sponsor-item.forMobile.Cashfish'];
        for (var i = 0; i < sel.length; i++) {
            var n = document.querySelector(sel[i]);
            if (!n || !n.getBoundingClientRect) { continue; }
            var r = n.getBoundingClientRect(), vh = window.innerHeight || document.documentElement.clientHeight;

    var toastTimer = null;
    function toast(html) {

    // GA4 events. follow_team / follow_league / unfollow_* on a tap (the type is in the name: no custom dimension needed);

    function track(action, type, extra) {

    function renderChips() {

        if (!holders.length) { return; }
        var d = load(), html = '', k;
        for (k in d.t) { if (d.t.hasOwnProperty(k)) { html += '<span class="bt-follow-chip">★ ' + esc(d.t[k]) + '<button type="button" data-unfollow-type="team" data-unfollow-id="' + esc(k) + '" aria-label="×">×</button></span>'; } }
        for (k in d.l) { if (d.l.hasOwnProperty(k)) { html += '<span class="bt-follow-chip">★ ' + esc(d.l[k]) + '<button type="button" data-unfollow-type="league" data-unfollow-id="' + esc(k) + '" aria-label="×">×</button></span>'; } }
        for (var i = 0; i < holders.length; i++) { holders[i].innerHTML = html ? '<div class="bt-follow-chips"><span class="bt-follow-chips-cap">' + esc(T['following']) + ':</span>' + html + '</div>' : ''; }
    }
    document.addEventListener('click', function (ev) {
        var el = ev.target;
        while (el && el !== document.body) {
            if (el.className && typeof el.className === 'string' && /(^|\s)bt-follow(\s|$)/.test(el.className)) {
                ev.preventDefault();
                toggle(el.getAttribute('data-follow-type'), el.getAttribute('data-follow-id'), el.getAttribute('data-follow-name'));
                return;
            }
            if (el.getAttribute && el.getAttribute('data-unfollow-id')) {
                ev.preventDefault();
                var type = el.getAttribute('data-unfollow-type'), id = el.getAttribute('data-unfollow-id'), d = load();

            }

        }
    });

        ids: function () { var d = load(); return { teams: ids(d.t), leagues: ids(d.l) }; },
        renderChips: renderChips,

    function init() { paintAll(); renderChips(); presence(); }

</script>

<script>
(function () {
    var inp = document.getElementById('header-search');
    if (!inp || !window.XMLHttpRequest) { return; }
    var form = inp.form || inp.parentNode, T = {"upcoming-matches":"Upcoming matches","teams":"Teams","leagues":"Leagues","search-see-all":"See all results"};
    var URL = "https:\/\/betimate.com\/en\/service\/search-suggest", SEARCH = "https:\/\/betimate.com\/en\/search";
    var box = document.createElement('div'); box.className = 'bt-ss'; box.setAttribute('hidden', 'hidden'); box.setAttribute('role', 'listbox');
    form.appendChild(box);
    var timer = null, xhr = null, last = '', items = [], cur = -1, cache = {};
    function esc(s) { return String(s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, function (c) { return { '&': '&', '<': '<', '>': '>', '"': '"', "'": ''' }[c]; }); }
    function when(ts) { try { var d = new Date(ts * 1000); return ('0' + d.getDate()).slice(-2) + '/' + ('0' + (d.getMonth() + 1)).slice(-2) + ' ' + ('0' + d.getHours()).slice(-2) + ':' + ('0' + d.getMinutes()).slice(-2); } catch (e) { return ''; } }
    function track(type) { try { if (typeof window.gtag === 'function') { window.gtag('event', 'search_suggest_click', { suggest_type: type }); } } catch (e) {} }
    function hide() { box.setAttribute('hidden', 'hidden'); box.innerHTML = ''; items = []; cur = -1; }
    function render(q, d) {
        var html = '', n = 0;
        function sec(title, list, type) {
            if (!list || !list.length) { return; }
            html += '<div class="bt-ss-h">' + esc(title) + '</div>';
            for (var i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
                var it = list[i], sub = type === 'match' ? (when(it.time) + (it.league ? ' · ' + esc(it.league) : '')) : esc(it.league || it.country || '');
                var icon = type === 'team' && it.logo ? '<img src="' + esc(it.logo) + '" alt="" loading="lazy">' : '<span class="bt-ss-d">' + (type === 'match' ? '⚽' : type === 'team' ? '⚑' : '🏆') + '</span>';
                html += '<a class="bt-ss-i" role="option" data-type="' + type + '" href="' + esc(it.url) + '">' + icon + '<span class="bt-ss-t"><span class="bt-ss-n">' + esc(it.name) + '</span>' + (sub ? '<span class="bt-ss-s">' + sub + '</span>' : '') + '</span></a>';
                n++;
            }
        }
        sec(T['upcoming-matches'], d.matches, 'match'); sec(T['teams'], d.teams, 'team'); sec(T['leagues'], d.leagues, 'league');
        if (!n) { hide(); return; }
        html += '<a class="bt-ss-all" data-type="all" href="' + esc(SEARCH + '?s=' + encodeURIComponent(q)) + '#gsc.tab=0&gsc.q=' + encodeURIComponent(q) + '">' + esc(T['search-see-all']) + ' ›</a>';
        box.innerHTML = html; box.removeAttribute('hidden');
        items = box.querySelectorAll('a'); cur = -1;
    }
    function ask(q) {
        if (cache[q]) { render(q, cache[q]); return; }
        if (xhr) { try { xhr.abort(); } catch (e) {} }
        xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
        xhr.open('GET', URL + '?q=' + encodeURIComponent(q), true);
        xhr.onreadystatechange = function () {
            if (xhr.readyState !== 4) { return; }
            if (xhr.status === 200) { try { var d = JSON.parse(xhr.responseText); cache[q] = d; if (inp.value.trim() === q) { render(q, d); } } catch (e) { hide(); } }
            else { hide(); }
        };
        xhr.send(null);
    }
    inp.addEventListener('input', function () {
        var q = inp.value.trim();
        clearTimeout(timer);
        if (q.length < 2) { hide(); last = ''; return; }
        if (q === last) { return; }

    });

        if (box.hasAttribute('hidden') || !items.length) { return; }
        if (ev.keyCode === 40 || ev.keyCode === 38) {                       // down / up

            cur = ev.keyCode === 40 ? (cur + 1) % items.length : (cur - 1 + items.length) % items.length;

    inp.addEventListener('focus', function () { var q = inp.value.trim(); if (q.length >= 2 && cache[q]) { render(q, cache[q]); } });
})();
</script>
